properties.name: storage.s3.bucket-name
properties.description: AWS S3 bucket name where user documents will be stored.

properties.name: storage.s3.region
properties.description: AWS S3 region where the bucket is located.

properties.name: storage.s3.endpoint
properties.description: AWS S3 endpoint URL. This is useful for local development with tools like LocalStack.

properties.name: storage.s3.key-prefix
properties.description: A prefix to be added to all keys in the S3 bucket. This can be used to organize files within the bucket.

properties.name: storage.s3.path-style-access
properties.description: A boolean flag to enable or disable path-style access for S3. This is useful for local development with tools like LocalStack.

properties.name: storage.s3.access-key
properties.description: AWS S3 access key for authentication. This is required if you are not using the default AWS credentials provider chain.

properties.name: storage.s3.secret-key
properties.description: AWS S3 secret key for authentication. This is required if you are not using the default AWS credentials provider chain.
